title: Wedbush raises the bar for two AI storage stocks
excerpt: Seagate Technology (STX) and Western Digital (WDC) supply high-capacity hard drives used by cloud providers to store the growing volumes of data produced by...
content_html:
Seagate Technology (STX) and Western Digital (WDC) supply high-capacity hard drives used by cloud providers to store the growing volumes of data produced by artificial intelligence workloads.

The companies have become two of the market's most closely watched AI infrastructure stocks as hyperscalers expand data-center capacity and reserve hard-drive supply years in advance.

Both stocks moved sharply lower on July 27 despite a bullish analyst call.

Seagate shares fell about 6.1% to $800 around midday July 27, and Western Digital declined about 6.1% to $487.87.

Seagate will report fiscal fourth-quarter and full-year results after the market closes on July 28. Western Digital is scheduled to report on Aug. 5.

The reports will show whether limited hard-drive supply is still helping the companies raise prices and protect margins.

They will also show whether production constraints are limiting the number of drives Seagate and Western Digital can deliver.

Wedbush analyst Matt Brysonraised his Seagate price target to $1,000 from $825 and lifted his Western Digital target to $650 from $540.

Bryson maintained Outperform ratings on both stocks.

Wedbush expects the HDD shortage to continue into 2027

Wedbush expects growing demand and limited hard-drive supply to continue well into 2027.

Cloud providers are reserving high-capacity drives as they expand storage for AI training data, inference output, customer records and backups.

The shortage gives Seagate and Western Digital more leverage in negotiating new customer agreements because hyperscalers have fewer suppliers with available capacity.

Related: Nvidia just locked down deal that changes AI race

However, higher market prices may take time to reach Seagate's financial results.

The company has already committed much of its fiscal 2027 capacity through long-term agreements that set volumes and pricing in advance.

That means the strongest benefit may come when existing agreements reset or Seagate signs contracts for later delivery periods at higher prices.

Seagate had declined about 17% in July entering Monday, while Western Digital had fallen more than 20%, according to Investor's Business Daily.

The pullback shows investors are waiting for more details on contract pricing, available capacity, and whether limited production will prevent the companies from accepting additional orders.

content_html_zh:
Seagate Technology (STX) 和 Western Digital (WDC) 提供大容量硬盘，供云提供商用来存储人工智能工作负载产生的不断增长的数据量。

随着超大规模企业提前数年扩大数据中心容量并储备硬盘供应，这两家公司已成为市场上最受关注的两家人工智能基础设施股票。

尽管分析师认为看涨，但这两只股票在 7 月 27 日仍大幅下跌。

7 月 27 日中午左右，希捷股价下跌约 6.1% 至 800 美元，西部数据下跌约 6.1% 至 487.87 美元。

希捷将于 7 月 28 日收盘后公布第四财季和全年业绩。 西部数据定于 8 月 5 日发布报告。

报告将显示有限的硬盘供应是否仍在帮助公司提高价格并保护利润。

他们还将展示生产限制是否限制了希捷和西部数据可以提供的硬盘数量。

Wedbush 分析师 Matt Bryson 将希捷目标股价从 825 美元上调至 1,000 美元，将西部数据目标股价从 540 美元上调至 650 美元。

布赖森维持这两只股票的跑赢大盘评级。

Wedbush 预计 HDD 短缺将持续到 2027 年

Wedbush 预计需求增长和硬盘供应有限的情况将持续到 2027 年。

云提供商在扩展人工智能训练数据、推理输出、客户记录和备份的存储时，正在预留大容量驱动器。

这种短缺使希捷和西部数据在谈判新客户协议时拥有更多筹码，因为超大规模企业拥有可用产能的供应商较少。

相关：英伟达刚刚敲定了改变人工智能竞赛的交易

然而，较高的市场价格可能需要一段时间才能达到希捷的财务业绩。

该公司已经通过提前确定产量和定价的长期协议承诺了 2027 财年的大部分产能。

这意味着当现有协议重置或希捷以更高的价格签署稍后交付期的合同时，可能会带来最大的好处。

据《投资者商业日报》报道，截至周一，希捷 7 月份股价下跌约 17%，而西部数据则下跌超过 20%。

此次回调表明投资者正在等待有关合同定价、可用产能以及有限产量是否会阻止公司接受额外订单的更多细节。
